evidence:
Reviewed only quality #31. Workbook Quality Checks!32 and Internal Quality Checks!32 require whole-collection quantifiers and preservation guards that permit legitimate effects; the skill reference lines 131-132 applies the same bar. The frozen template's functional criterion uses conjunctive legs, while the current repository policy correctly keeps independently owned outcomes separate.

Frozen task references below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task. Functional prompt.md:227-236 explicitly executes all five unsupported families separately and continues after failure; judge.toml:147,154 requires refusal and appropriate preservation for each. S05 checks four distinct parent-document/storage operations (prompt:189-197; judge:112). S07 requires separate fetch and Image attempts, including when an earlier refusal aborts execution (prompt:204-210; judge:119,126). The loop, asynchronous-error and console collections are explicit: all three loop forms (prompt:242-267), both JS/HTML timers (310-327), all three Promise rejections (333-355), four console levels in order (361-366), all object/array values (372-375), all three syntax-colouring languages (406-408), and both Auto-run settings plus the intermediate-edit exclusion (394-400).

Durability is a complete inventory comparison rather than a sample: Functional prompt:426-432 records every identity/title/filename/source/revision before the one restart, includes HTML Beta and the CSS/JS fixtures, rereads every record exactly once and independently compares the complete example multiplicities. judge.toml:364 expressly says 'Compare the whole recorded collection'. S23 repeats the complete dirty title/filename/source and saved-field/revision checks with roles reversed (prompt:438-443; judge:385,392,532). S24 expands collision and empty-title checks across creation and current-revision updates (prompt:450-455; judge:406,413), with fresh records after each attempt. Polish prompt P02 enumerates all 11 requested control purposes and requires actual keyboard reachability for every enabled purpose; its names/reachability/focus criteria do not waive a reached member's missing focus. Visual prompt requires all four named desktop surfaces and both offered themes; the deliberately bounded responsive comparison is stated as at least two surfaces, not mislabeled as all surfaces.

The unchanged guards are scoped to required product state. Functional prompt:15 permits retained historical console rows and compares new marker counts. S05:197 allows legitimate host title/status changes and protects the forbidden marker plus otherwise-unused storage key. S07:207 allows a caught blocked operation to complete legitimate effects and updates the last-good baseline. S22:428 ignores collection order and unrelated display metadata; 432 ignores display-only example timestamps/status badges. S03:159-160 and app_context Runtime expectations permit static restored pictures. S16:383 permits unrelated status/duration labels after clearing log rows. S34:461 allows either starting theme, does not require recolouring authored preview content, and preserves actual draft/output state through both changes. These checks do not require a successful Save target's revision to stay unchanged.

Verified the current index SHA256 1f5386d67aaf893d665eeaf95954f4997ac41558894723d30cea4c5e8443797f and all 102 indexed current_golden artifact hashes. The raw manifest binds this input hash, functional judge f8585931b96bb448c9ed70d4c24042b28bbdd330f312066eaa4f4d9e075edb52 and prompt 11a0648ba9a2d4a6d7220b4c35cdf45dab1b6ff7b94f47d0e4c647450d7d1987; independently recomputed both hashes and all 23 frozen solution-file hashes, and checked all 22 recorded actual-app hashes against them. In post-results.json (SHA256 c6643004926913c89df7cac102412e49236f4416598e1ac1a4e8082d37c7e945), independently compared required fields in the raw S22 before/after arrays: six records, six unique identities, JS/HTML/CSS present, one successful restart with changed PID, and five example choices with identical multiplicities. Raw S23 contains two role-reversed 409 refusals, advanced winning revisions, unchanged winning records and exact retained dirty fields. S08 contains five separate refusal observations. S24 contains all eight create/update invalid-title attempts, valid-write controls, 400/409 refusals, and before/after arrays of ten records with every required field unchanged. These are observed scripted results, not inferred from their pass flags. surface-results.json (SHA256 375f64d64ae6c71aab79e1eec4aa0ab58d975408ef9cb53c2df9bb0274525c11) records all 11 named/reached control purposes and a compatibility control where host title changes from 'Status: Complete ? 4.5 ms' to 'Status: Complete ? 5.0 ms', while the storage probe remains null and all four snippet accesses are blocked.

No confirmed row-31 defect remains. Evidence is source review plus hash-verified existing local scripted observations; no new Docker probe was needed. This is not execution of private deterministic checkers or the configured LLM judge, and does not establish full judge duration, an Oracle/model score, reward ranking or hosted acceptance. Those unmeasured run-level requirements remain outside this row's source/collection conclusion.
counterexample: Tried plausible broken alternatives against the written bar: preserve only Primary/Second while dropping HTML Beta; duplicate one example during restart; reject only eval while allowing Worker; validate title collisions only on updates; or protect stale Save only when A wins. They cannot satisfy the explicit whole-inventory, five-family, create/update and reversed-role requirements cited above. Considered conforming alternatives: reorder library/examples, change unrelated display metadata, update host title for run status, retain console history, use native/composite keyboard controls, or restore a static successful preview. The stated allowances accept these; the raw host-title compatibility control independently demonstrates the important unchanged-guard case.
